profile.professionalTitle: Full Stack Developer | Computer Engineering Student
profile.shortIntroduction: Passionate Computer Engineering student and full-stack developer building robust, user-centric web applications and dynamic software solutions.
profile.about: I am a dedicated Computer Engineering undergraduate at Dharmsinh Desai University with a strong foundation in full-stack web development, software engineering principles, and database management. My technical focus revolves around the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js), scalable architecture design, and creating impactful digital tools. I enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and developing modern, responsive applications from concept to deployment.

projects.title: MealMate
projects.shortDescription: Smart meal planning and recipe suggestion mobile application that assists users in organizing dietary preferences, recipes, and ingredient tracking.
projects.description: MealMate is a mobile meal planning and recipe suggestion application designed to streamline dietary management. The platform features intuitive recipe discovery, meal scheduling, pantry management, and personalized nutrition planning to help users maintain balanced lifestyles efficiently.
keyFeatures: Dynamic meal scheduling and dietary planning

projects.title: SmartDeviceMatch
projects.shortDescription: Intelligent device recommendation and comparison engine that helps consumers find optimal hardware based on customized requirements and budgets.
projects.description: SmartDeviceMatch is an intelligent device recommendation engine designed to simplify consumer hardware selection. By analyzing technical specifications, price-to-performance benchmarks, and user-defined constraints, the platform delivers tailored gadget recommendations and side-by-side hardware comparisons.
keyFeatures: Multi-attribute device comparison and specification matrix
Custom filtering by budget, hardware category, and performance metrics
Modular component architecture for seamless catalog updates

projects.title: GRIP Career Readiness Platform
projects.shortDescription: Collaborative career preparation platform empowering students and early-career engineers with targeted assessment tools and interview readiness.
projects.description: GRIP Career Readiness Platform is a collaborative career development platform built to empower engineering students and aspiring professionals. It provides structured learning roadmaps, mock assessment workflows, technical interview preparation modules, and peer collaboration tools to accelerate career placement success.
keyFeatures: Structured technical career roadmaps and readiness checkpoints
Comprehensive interview preparation modules and practice assessments
Progress tracking dashboards with actionable skill gap analysis
Collaborative learning workflows and resource curation

projects.title: StockRiskTracker
projects.shortDescription: Financial portfolio risk assessment and monitoring application tracking market volatility, asset exposure, and downside risks.
projects.description: StockRiskTracker is a financial analytics tool focused on equity risk assessment and portfolio volatility monitoring. The system calculates core risk metrics such as volatility, drawdown, and sector exposure, providing investors with actionable risk visualizations to safeguard capital in fluctuating market environments.
keyFeatures: Asset allocation and sector concentration breakdown
Real-time or simulated price monitoring and trend analysis
Interactive financial charting and risk exposure alerts
